name: discord_get_audit_log
description: Read a guild's audit log (who did what). Provide `guild_id`; optional `limit` (1-100, default 50), `action_type` (numeric audit event, e.g. 22 = MEMBER_BAN_ADD, 20 = MEMBER_KICK, 10 = CHANNEL_CREATE), and `user_id` (filter to one actor). Requires VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.

action_type.description: Numeric audit log event type to filter by (optional).

user_id.description: Filter to actions performed by this user id (optional).
